hints.title: Factored Child Decomposition
hints.text: Each valid product pair of smaller numbers can form the left and right children of a factored root.

hints.title: Ascending Order Processing
hints.text: Sort the array so factors are evaluated before products.

hints.title: Multiplicative Subtree Recurrence
hints.text: For each root value x and existing factor y, if x / y is also present, add dp[y] * dp[x / y] to dp[x], taking sum modulo 10^9+7.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Sorted array traversal checking factor pairings with hash map lookup.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive branching without state memoization causes exponential duplicate tree generation.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dictionary stores tree counts per unique root value in O(N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sort array first to ensure all child factor counts are computed before evaluating composite roots.
